# n8n_project_members (Data Source)

Fetches the list of members for an n8n project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project identifier

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) List of project members (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) User email address
- `first_name` (String) User first name
- `last_name` (String) User last name
- `role` (String) User role in the project (e.g., project:admin, project:editor, project:viewer)
- `user_id` (String) User identifier
